summary: Q2 FY27 on 7 Nov: net profit about Rs 1,127 cr (+64% y/y), revenue Rs 3,676 cr (+35%) (press reports based on the NSE filing; one source says Rs 1,140 cr). +16.3% in a week, RSI 85, 24% above EMA50, volume 4.2x its 50-day average (brief): the untested parabolic house rule lowers confidence, no veto. Bear case: a results spike this steep often gives some back; P/E near 90 per one aggregator. Tags: reason=house; attention=yes
